package fixturemigrate

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strconv"
	"testing"

	"github.com/RELAXccc/bun-fixture-migrate/fixturechange"
)

// TestRenderLargeCorpus renders a set of 1001 changes with this commit's
// generator: a third inserts, a third updates, a third deletes.
func TestRenderLargeCorpus(t *testing.T) {
	out := os.Getenv("CORPUS_OUT")
	if out == "" {
		t.Skip("CORPUS_OUT")
	}
	cfg := &Config{Fixture: "fixture.yml", Out: "migrations", SeedGuardTable: "corpus_translations",
		Models: map[string]*Model{"Translation": {Table: "corpus_translations", Key: []string{"locale", "key"},
			Ref: "key", Serial: true}}}
	if err := cfg.Prepare(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	res := &Result{Tables: fixturechange.Tables{"Translation": {Name: "corpus_translations", ID: "id", Key: "key",
		Serial: true}}, Head: "fixture.yml", Base: "the state file"}
	for i := 0; i <= 1000; i++ {
		k := fmt.Sprintf("k%05d", i)
		key := fixturechange.Values{"locale": fixturechange.Lit("de"), "key": fixturechange.Lit(k)}
		switch i % 3 {
		case 0:
			res.Changes = append(res.Changes, fixturechange.Change{Model: "Translation", Kind: fixturechange.Insert,
				Key: key, New: fixturechange.Values{"id": fixturechange.Lit(strconv.Itoa(100000 + i)),
					"locale": fixturechange.Lit("de"), "key": fixturechange.Lit(k),
					"value": fixturechange.Lit(fmt.Sprintf("Wert %d", i)), "note": fixturechange.Null()}})
		case 1:
			res.Changes = append(res.Changes, fixturechange.Change{Model: "Translation", Kind: fixturechange.Update,
				Key: key, Old: fixturechange.Values{"value": fixturechange.Lit("alt"), "note": fixturechange.Null()},
				New: fixturechange.Values{"value": fixturechange.Lit(fmt.Sprintf("neu %d", i)),
					"note": fixturechange.Lit("x")}})
		default:
			res.Changes = append(res.Changes, fixturechange.Change{Model: "Translation", Kind: fixturechange.Delete,
				Key: key, Old: fixturechange.Values{"id": fixturechange.Lit(strconv.Itoa(i)),
					"locale": fixturechange.Lit("de"), "key": fixturechange.Lit(k), "value": fixturechange.Lit("weg"),
					"note": fixturechange.Null()}})
		}
	}
	src, err := Render(cfg, "many translations", "20260104000000", res)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(out, FileName("20260104000000", "many translations")), src, 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
